purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Bobasi Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved), then re-cropped and upscaled around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation. This constituency's downloaded Form 34B is a 4-page document, but its internal page order does not match ascending sheet numbers: download page 1 is sheet 'FORM34B07' (a signature/handover page marked 'Page 4 of 4'), download page 2 is sheet 'FORM34B06' and contains the constituency's TOTAL row directly above the Constituency Returning Officer's signature block, and download page 4 is sheet 'FORM34B17' (mid-listing, no TOTAL row). The TOTAL row on download page 2 reconciles exactly to the governed P23 denominator, confirming it is the genuine constituency grand total despite the out-of-sequence page ordering. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election session handshake (id=5).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (BOBASI, code 264) was read from the polling-station-code prefixes ('452641...') and cross-checked against the Constituency Returning Officer's handwritten 'Bobasi' annotation and IEBC returning-officer stamp on the same page before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: This evidence establishes a source-verified row under the extraction contract: the printed TOTAL row's Registered Voters figure (106,060) reconciles exactly to the governed P23 constituency denominator, and the four candidate cells sum exactly to the printed Total Valid Votes figure (67,465). Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
